description_en: Query the rule libraries that are currently available for audit. This operation returns only rule libraries that are active for auditing. To view the contents of a custom rule library, use the DownloadAuditNote API
description_zh: 查询用户当前可供审核的规则库信息，只能查询到当前可用于审核的规则库。如果您想看到自定义规则库的具体内容，请使用 DownloadAuditNote 接口
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi get-available-audit-notes --workspace-id llm-xx --note-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAvailableAuditNotes

parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
